title: Auto-Renew Credit on Restore-Day Extension Years, Domain Registrations
content:
Under Domain Registrations, a domain whose auto-renew setting is on earns the restore-day autopay credit, one of the restore-day credits, on the extension years ordered on its restore day.

**Rule.** The restore-day autopay credit is USD 0.50 for each restore-day year where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the order, USD 0.20 for each restore-day year where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded, and nothing where auto-renew is off.

**Restated by input and result**

- Auto-renew on, no declined auto-renew attempt on the domain in the 12 whole months before the order: USD 0.50 for each restore-day year.
- Auto-renew on, one or more such declined attempts: USD 0.20 for each restore-day year.
- Auto-renew off: nothing, whatever the decline history.

**Window.** A declined attempt falls inside the 12 whole months while its date is fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the order, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

**Hypothetical worked cases**

| Restore-day years | Auto-renew | Declines in the window | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | on | none | USD 3.50 |
| 7 | on | 2 | USD 1.40 |
| 7 | off | none | nothing |
